description: Saves posts into one of your projects. Pass postIds (from search_outliers, get_trending_outliers or get_project) and/or urls (public TikTok, Instagram or YouTube post links); up to 25 per call. A link resolves only when we already have the post (crawl_profile its creator first if not); anything unresolved comes back in notFound with the reason. Posts already in the project are reported in alreadyPresent, not duplicated. Free. Cost: free.

postIds.description: Internal post ids (from search results or get_project)

projectId.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project

urls.description: Public post links to save (postIds + urls <= 25 per call)

name: add_project_posts
title: Save Posts to a Project
